_doc: Predeclared before any final-protocol GCN result was produced (2026-11-17). Executed by scripts/final_audit/select_dev.py. Holdout is never read for any of this.
selection_metric: mean over (fold, seed) of validation AP on the 'hard' negatives of the development CV folds
tie_rule: candidates within 0.005 AP of the best are tied; among tied candidates prefer the higher mean popmatch-validation AP, then fewer parameters (or the non-ensemble)

stage_C.combo_rule: merge the overrides of every stage-B config (excluding variant/arch changes) whose mean val AP beats L3_base by >= combo_min_gain_ap; when two improving overrides set the same key, keep the larger gain

final_candidates: best GCN config (stage C, 3 seeds x 5 folds)
deployment_setting: ranking candidate NEW indications for drugs already in PrimeKG (approved/investigational drugs with known contraindication / off-label records). The mechanism-only variant is reported for the novel-compound setting but is not the deployed model unless it wins the rule.
